brand.legal_note: Prim is the product noun and category. Eidos AGI is the company; this pack is the Prim product surface, not the company house kit.
brand.positioning: A file that stores information, and tools that interact with it.
brand.tagline: The source of truth. Everything else is a view.

usage_rules: Never stretch, skew, or add drop shadows, gradients, or outlines.
Never use the Eidos tridot for Prim.
Gold folio on ink. Ink folio on paper. Cream folio only as reverse on ink.
The mark is a bound file: spine plus page with a folded corner. Keep both parts.
Do not cheer. Do not hype. Prim is infrastructure.

files.note: Vendored from google/fonts ofl/instrumentsans (InstrumentSans[wdth,wght].ttf), renamed for a stable @font-face URL.

type_note: Prim prefers Instrument Sans + IBM Plex Mono on the web. Both are OFL and shipped in-pack. kit.css @font-face loads these files; do not substitute Space Grotesk or Inter unless this pack says so.

do: Name the file. Name the view.
Speak as infrastructure, not a launch.
dont: Eidos company doctrine or the house brass/cream story.

content_blocks.name: Lede
content_blocks.when: Opening summary. One paragraph under the title.
refuses: hero subcopy with three clauses of hype

content_blocks.name: PageHero
content_blocks.when: Page header. One h1. Mark optional.

content_blocks.name: NavRow
content_blocks.when: A selectable row in a rail or chat list. Title plus a quieter lede. Optional ink mark.
refuses: accent stripe or color bar on the leading edge of the selected row

deprecated.note: Eidos cold blue is not Prim. Do not import it. Prim gold is #e8c547.
